notes.title: The Terrifying Cleaning experience!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497168/b20d581784c0c7099f27aa90dd34de1fe1b91e2c.png[/img]
[u][b]With the upcoming release of the game and the publishing of the steam community, i'll leave more news/details about the game just for you![/b][/u]
[list]
[*]  [i][b]The game might have a VR build in future releases.[/b][/i]
[*]  [i][b]The game will have a demo before release "Prologue".[/b][/i]
[*]  [i][b]A large part of the game is fully finished, polishing the last details for the release.[/b][/i]
[/list]

[u][h1]The Perfect Job[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497168/160ef62217c58842d174c5157986860ce3f1d9ce.png[/img]
[i][b]Imagine.. Having one entire amusement park just for yourself, you could eat all you want, run around and enter any ride as you please. 

That would be perfect in any life scenario, but in Magical Queen's Land, an infamous park in it's last week of operation, you're in a hurry to worry just about your new work.[/b][/i]

[u][h1]A Park, or something else?[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497168/dc21e4a06daeca45902cfb0f50f18df9c37ce952.png[/img]
[i][b] This place in the past was something else..  They want to hide it, but the visitors didn't forgot about the last events and stories,  it is said that this location used to be a palace before, built from the ashes of a century-old cemetery.  We're not truly sure about the origins, but we know this is a cursed land. 
[/b][/i]
[u][h1]Ghosts & Stress[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497168/7cc16c5c576801648168cd5b07a59eba842144e4.png[/img]
[i][b]We have a lot of work to take care of, to earn our freedom from jail we should finish this part-time job, there's something wrong about the situation,  no one seems to be working here, and we're strictly forced to stay inside unless we finish our tasks.  Claustrophobia, weird noises, props moving by themselves and the chance of a ride triggering by itself is just part of the service turn.  The fantasy sculpture creatures come out, we are on their land..  And they want us out  ¿How will you leave alive?[/b][/i]

[u][h1]Game Details & Development[/h1][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497168/6348b205798a668aef3f2a06606c22278c12eef5.png[/img]
[i][b]Magical Queen's Land has been in development for a whole year,  the idea was to create a very tense simulator where we take control of a dirty situation "taking inspiration from Viscera Cleanup Detail", cleaning in this case, mixing psychological horror elements and focused in fears from those rusty characters from old playground in our childhood,  the Queen is based in a real tall statue in mexico.

With a cold bluish 3D look, this game uses shadows as a gameplay mechanic, using Lights as a source for salvation, while the creatures can interact with everything, like doors, lighting bulbs and even your stuff "mop, flashlight, etc", the challenge of the game is to organize and manage your next actions, ¿Which paper bin i should first clear? ¿Where do i go after that? 

Time's ticking, and before 3AM, which is where the park locks you down, you must be done with your tasks and leave, that's of course if the fantasy creatures didn't mess with you, which they could at anytime! As you're very noisy.

This is my last horror game at the moment, no plans for more right now.

[b][h2]Let me know what you think about this upcoming game![/h2][/b]
[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42497168/048f02a83e78ac2bf0f00208964c1edaaffe6030.png[/img]
